'''Drongians''' were the inhabitants of [[Drong II]].<ref name="Truce">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Drongians were mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and published in [[1996]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Truce" />
